package handler

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	roomentity "GENRE_MODULE/game/entities/game_room"
	playerentity "GENRE_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/rules"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/clock"
)

type scenarioGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g scenarioGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	if e := g[id]; e != nil {
		return e, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing %d", id)
}
func (g scenarioGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, cats []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	out := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		e, err := g.Get(ctx, id, cats[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[i] = e
	}
	return out, nil
}

type scenarioCommitter struct{ reject atomic.Bool }

func (c *scenarioCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error {
	if c.reject.Load() {
		return errors.New("injected rejection")
	}
	return nil
}

type scenarioFixture struct {
	engine    *nest.NestMgr
	room      *roomentity.GameRoom
	players   [2]*playerentity.Player
	outsider  *playerentity.Player
	now       atomic.Int64
	committer *scenarioCommitter
}

func newScenario(t *testing.T) *scenarioFixture {
	t.Helper()
	roomentity.RegisterEntity()
	playerentity.RegisterEntity()
	RegisterScenarioNestHandlers()
	f := &scenarioFixture{committer: &scenarioCommitter{}}
	f.now.Store(1800000000000)
	clock.SetSource(func() time.Time { return time.UnixMilli(f.now.Load()) })
	t.Cleanup(func() { clock.SetSource(nil) })
	getter := scenarioGetter{}
	makeEntity := func(unique int64, kind entity.EntityKind) entity.IThreadSafeEntity {
		id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(unique, kind)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		e, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: kind})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		getter[id] = e
		return e
	}
	f.room = makeEntity(81001, roomentity.EntityKindGameRoom).(*roomentity.GameRoom)
	for i := range f.players {
		f.players[i] = makeEntity(int64(82001+i), playerentity.EntityKindPlayer).(*playerentity.Player)
	}
	// 有效但不在房间名单的身份，用于验证业务成员授权而非只验证实体不存在。
	f.outsider = makeEntity(82003, playerentity.EntityKindPlayer).(*playerentity.Player)
	f.engine = nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(getter), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(f.committer), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 2, QueueCap: 64}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if err := f.engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := f.engine.Shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	if err := sender.NewScenarioSender(f.engine).Sync_ScenarioOpen(context.Background(), f.room.ID(), []int64{f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID()}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return f
}
func (f *scenarioFixture) state(t *testing.T) rules.State {
	t.Helper()
	var s rules.State
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(f.room.Dao().GetState()), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return s
}
func (f *scenarioFixture) command(t *testing.T, player int, kind string) rules.Command {
	t.Helper()
	s := f.state(t)
	return rules.Command{Seq: s.Last[f.players[player].ID()].Command.Seq + 1, Revision: s.Revision, Kind: kind}
}
func (f *scenarioFixture) send(player int, c rules.Command) (rules.Result, error) {
	return sender.NewScenarioSender(f.engine).MultiSync_ScenarioCommand(context.Background(), f.room.ID(), f.players[player].ID(), c)
}
func (f *scenarioFixture) do(t *testing.T, player int, kind string) rules.Result {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := f.send(player, f.command(t, player, kind))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return r
}
func (f *scenarioFixture) refuse(t *testing.T, player int, c rules.Command) {
	t.Helper()
	before := f.room.Dao().GetState()
	coins := f.players[player].Dao().GetCoins()
	if _, err := f.send(player, c); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("command accepted")
	}
	if before != f.room.Dao().GetState() || coins != f.players[player].Dao().GetCoins() {
		t.Fatal("refusal mutated DAO")
	}
}

func TestScenarioRetryAndConflict(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	c := f.command(t, 0, FIRST_COMMAND)
	first, err := f.send(0, c)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw := f.room.Dao().GetState()
	again, err := f.send(0, c)
	if err != nil || again != first || raw != f.room.Dao().GetState() {
		t.Fatal("retry changed result", err)
	}
	c.Choice++
	f.refuse(t, 0, c)
}
func TestScenarioCommitRejectionRollsBack(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	c := f.command(t, 0, FIRST_COMMAND)
	f.committer.reject.Store(true)
	f.refuse(t, 0, c)
	f.committer.reject.Store(false)
	if _, err := f.send(0, c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestScenarioStaleRevision(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	c := f.command(t, 1, FIRST_COMMAND)
	f.do(t, 0, FIRST_COMMAND)
	f.refuse(t, 1, c)
}
func TestScenarioMembership(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	s := f.state(t)
	if _, err := s.Apply(999, rules.Command{Seq: 1, Kind: FIRST_COMMAND}, f.now.Load()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("outsider admitted")
	}
}
